title: We want to enrol our biochar in the European Biochar Certificate scheme to sell carbon removal credits but the documentation requirements are in German and English and keep changing; we've already spent six months on paperwork without submitting a complete application.

record.text: We want to enrol our biochar in the European Biochar Certificate scheme to sell carbon removal credits but the documentation requirements are in German and English and keep changing; we've already spent six months on paperwork without submitting a complete application.
record.detail: The European Biochar Certificate is the main route for us to register carbon removal credits and charge a premium to buyers who need documented carbon sequestration. We have been trying to prepare an application for almost a year. The scheme requires detailed chain-of-custody records, feedstock declarations, specific lab analyses, and a written quality management description that maps to their framework document, which is updated periodically. Our team speaks Serbian and we have one colleague, Jovana Filipović, who handles correspondence in English, but the technical language in the EBC framework is not straightforward even for native speakers. We have collected most of the required lab data and we have roughly 18 months of production records. What we are missing is someone who can read the current framework critically, identify exactly what gaps we still have in our documentation, and help us write the quality management section in a way that satisfies the auditors. We have a small budget set aside for this, around 4,000 EUR, and we would like to submit a complete application before the end of the year.
